content.short: marginfi is a decentralized lending protocol on Solana featuring a robust risk management engine and LST solutions.
content.description: marginfi is a leading decentralized, over-collateralized lending and borrowing protocol built natively on the Solana blockchain. Designed for maximum capital efficiency and security, the platform features a sophisticated risk management engine that enables users to manage their portfolios with institutional-grade precision. marginfi allows participants to earn interest on their deposits and access liquidity through a seamless and transparent on-chain interface, leveraging Solana's high speed and low latency. Beyond basic lending, the ecosystem includes LST (a liquid staking token for SOL) and YBX, a yield-bearing stablecoin backed by diversified collateral.
content.meta: marginfi provides decentralized lending, borrowing, and liquid staking services on Solana. Discover marginfi and more on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
